hosts.title: Manual thermostat hosts
hosts.description: Optional hostnames or IP addresses to query in addition to SSDP discovery.

pollIntervalMs.title: Background refresh interval (milliseconds)
pollIntervalMs.description: Set to 0 to disable background polling.

removeStaleAccessories.title: Remove undiscovered cached thermostats
removeStaleAccessories.description: Leave disabled unless a thermostat has been permanently removed. Keeping stale accessories avoids HomeKit churn when a thermostat misses discovery.
